title: Quest Line 03 — The Winterheart
premise: The five Frostbells are recovered, the Herald has retreated into the glacier, and the sixth bell — the original Krampus Bell — rings from somewhere beneath Frostpine every night at midnight. The final chapter: descend to the Winterheart itself, learn what the creature beneath the ice truly is, and decide whether the Winter Chorus is ever rung at all.
theme: What do you do with a mercy that ends the world?

chapters.name: Chapter I — The Midnight Bell
chapters.description: Every night at midnight, the sixth bell rings alone. Find who — or what — is pulling the rope.

chapters.name: Chapter II — The Descent
chapters.description: Beneath the glacier lies the Old Chapel of the Winterheart — and the truth about Team Krampus's founder.

chapters.name: Chapter III — The Heart of Winter
chapters.description: The Winterheart beats. The Herald gathers. Krampus returns — not as an enemy.

chapters.name: Chapter IV — The Winter Chorus
chapters.description: Six bells. One heart. One choice. The finale of the Krampus saga.
